paragraphs: Concourse sells an AI platform to enterprise finance departments. It connects directly to the ERP, data warehouse, billing system and CRM a company already runs.

Agents are adapted to a company's own data, logic and workflows, and can run autonomously or on triggers. They work through natural language against the financial stack. The company says every number traces back to its source and every workflow runs against evals built for that business. Results arrive in email, Slack, Teams, Excel and PowerPoint rather than a separate application. One named agent surfaces what changed, quantifies the impact and drafts commentary.

Finance teams use it across FP&A, accounting, treasury and audit. Concourse says it works with more than 100 finance departments. It describes building for every finance team, from two-person startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. On security it points to compliance with security and AI governance standards. It states there is no training on customer data.

quote.text: Concourse is the AI execution layer for enterprise finance.
